summary: Thin runtime adapter that points to the global pre-implementation workflow review Codex skill.
docstring: Runtime adapter only. The authoritative workflow lives in the global Codex skill pre-implementation-workflow-review. Inputs are preserved for routing and traceability; execution writes an adapter report with global_skill_name, global_skill_path, source_role, and next_action.
rule_reason: Added as a human-approved direction value gate after local basic skill work proved lower value than default runtime lane integration.
